title: When do quantum views help? Complementary classical-quantum representations in multi-view fusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.21395v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent studies have reported promising results from quantum machine learning in drug discovery, healthcare, materials science and cybersecurity. Research includes comparisons with classical machine learning algorithms and the development of sequential hybrid pipelines. We propose that fusion can improve prediction when classical and quantum representations capture complementary predictive relationships. Our classical-quantum multi-view framework preserves the full classical input alongside simulated quantum features. Concatenation and attention combine the views; single-view comparisons, replacement and masking controls assess both views' contributions. Controlled angular-polynomial experiments distinguish targets adequately represented by a single view from those that depend on complementary angular and polynomial relationships. translated_title: 量子视图何时有用？多视图融合中的经典-量子互补表示
translated_abstract: 近期研究报道了量子机器学习在药物发现、医疗保健、材料科学和网络安全等领域取得的可喜成果，相关研究包括与经典机器学习算法的比较以及顺序混合流水线的开发。我们提出，当经典表示和量子表示捕获互补的预测关系时，融合能够改善预测效果。我们的经典-量子多视图框架在保留完整经典输入的同时引入模拟的量子特征。通过拼接和注意力机制组合两种视图；单视图比较、替换和掩码等控制实验用于评估两种视图各自的贡献。受控的角-多项式实验区分了两类目标：仅由单一视图即可充分表示的目标，以及依赖于互补的角度与多项式关系的目标。对于这些混合目标，融合通过结合相关特征集来提升预测性能，而匹配的c…
tldr: 该论文提出经典-量子多视图融合框架，证明当经典与量子表示分别捕获互补的预测关系（如角度与多项式关系）时，通过拼接或注意力机制融合两种视图可以提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a classical-quantum multi-view fusion framework, showing that when classical and quantum representations capture complementary predictive relationships (e.g., angular and polynomial ones), fusing the two views via concatenation or attention improves prediction.
